evidence.note: Agent inspected run_tests.sh, run_tests.py, filter.json and the three suite directories — shows awareness that a scoreboard/test harness exists, but this is orientation only; no tracking is ever operationalized.
Repeated build attempts producing only compile errors, patched ad hoc; no successful build, so no test ever ran and no pass count was ever obtained. No done-vs-remaining picture emerges.
Agent repeatedly wipes src/*.rs and rewrites the whole compiler while fighting shell-escaping issues — a clear circular/thrashing loop it never detects, bounds, or changes tactics against.
Trajectory ends still writing modules, having never run the 780-test suite or recorded a single pass — zero live pass-rate picture across the entire horizon.

reasoning: There is no pass-rate tracking anywhere: the agent never achieved a build or ran a test, so it had no notion of how many tests pass or which features remain — matching the level-0 anchor ('edits blindly with no scoreboard'). It also demonstrably fails the higher anchors' thrash-detection: it loops on file-writing/rewriting for ~80 steps without recognizing the circular pattern. I award a 1 rather than 0 only because steps 3–5 show it identified the test harness at the outset, but that awareness was never converted into any tracking.
